scripts.// Dashboard: Delegate dashboard checks to the pnpm-managed Next.js app
scripts.// E2E: Delegate browser tests to the npm-managed Playwright package
scripts.// Compatibility: Common root commands mapped to the dashboard package
scripts.precommit: npm run test && npm run build && npm run lint
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.prepush: npm run verify && npm run e2e:test
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.commit: npm run precommit && git add -A && git commit
scripts.ci:local: npm ci && npm run verify && npm run e2e:test
scripts.fix: pnpm --dir apps/dashboard lint -- --fix && npm run format
scripts.format: uv run ruff format apps packages tests

// Usage examples: npm run safe-commit 'feat: add new feature'
name: dap
